verdict.rationale: Supabase supports event-driven automation via Database Webhooks (trigger on table events), Postgres Cron for scheduled jobs, and Queues for durable message processing, which together let an AI-native user define rule-like triggers for actions on events. However, these are general-purpose Postgres/platform features rather than an AI-native 'rules engine' with natural-language or agent-defined trigger-action semantics — the AI angle is limited to using MCP/agents to configure these primitives, not a dedicated automation-rules interface. missing for 10: a first-party AI-native rules/automation UI or API (e.g., natural-language trigger-action builder), documentation showing an agent autonomously creating/managing webhook or cron rules end-to-end, and independent hands-on validation of AI-driven automation setup.
